'''M9-G8''' was an [[astromech droid]] belonging to [[Resistance]] [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] [[Yolo Ziff]].<ref name="Flight Log" /> He<ref name="BuildR268" /> was stationed at the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]]. He co-piloted with Ziff in his [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] as part of [[Blue Squadron (Resistance)|Blue Squadron]]<ref name="Flight Log" /> during the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]].<ref name="Episode VII" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
M9-G8 first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|Star Wars]]''[[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|: Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], a film released in North America on [[December 18]], [[2015]].<ref name="Episode VII" /> He first received a designation in the sticker book ''[[Ultimate Sticker Collection: Star Wars: The Force Awakens]].''<ref name="USC">''[[Ultimate Sticker Collection: Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref>
